claims.claim_text: Aeva's proprietary FMCW 4D LiDAR-on-chip is the world's first integrated silicon-photonics LiDAR capable of measuring range up to 500 meters.
claims.subject: Aeva 4D LiDAR-on-chip
claims.source_quote: our core innovations within FMCW are intended to enable vehicles to see at significantly higher distances of up to 500 meters ... With the world s first LiDAR that is integrated onto a silicon photonics chip module, Aeva s proprietary FMCW technology combines instant velocity measurement for each pixel

claims.claim_text: Aeva has severe customer concentration with three customers accounting for 72% of accounts receivable as of December 31, 2025.
claims.subject: Aeva accounts receivable
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2025 three customers accounted for 72 % and as of December 31, 2024 five customers accounted for 68 % of accounts receivable, respectively.
